# 45-Minute Landing Page Review Plan

## 0:00–0:05 | Setup & First Impression
- Open the page in a fresh browser window (incognito, to avoid cached versions)
- Read through once without stopping. Note your gut reaction: Is the purpose clear within 5 seconds? Does anything feel off?
- Open a simple doc or notes file to log issues as you go

## 0:05–0:15 | Main Link & Functionality
- **Click the main call-to-action link.** Confirm it goes to the correct destination and loads properly
- Check whether it opens in the same tab or a new one (and whether that's intentional)
- Test every other link on the page: navigation, footer, social icons, email links
- If there's a form, submit a test entry and confirm it works (confirmation message, email received, etc.)
- Verify that images and any videos load

## 0:15–0:27 | Mobile Layout
- Open the page on an actual phone if possible; otherwise use browser dev tools (F12 → device toolbar)
- Check at a few widths: small phone (~375px), large phone (~430px), and tablet (~768px)
- Look for:
  - Text that's too small or gets cut off
  - Horizontal scrolling (there shouldn't be any)
  - Buttons and links that are easy to tap, not crowded together
  - Images that scale correctly
